A shim outside any checkout still resolves no tree, as at the base; python3 now reports the engine module missing (exit 1) instead of the engine file missing (exit 2). Every other value is the base capture, unchanged. 2026-10-08 (#1206, human-decided): orient frames the Lessons section's Viable tags and Hits bodies as untrusted under a one-line note; every s062.orient section was re-observed, and each equals the prior value once the note and the frames are removed. norm() masks the frame salt as <SALT>. 2026-10-08 (#1206, human-decided): a search now runs over each lesson's frontmatter as one key: value line per key in the one-line spelling --tags lists (Lesson.match_text), not the raw YAML text; s185's escaped-signature search for it's "quoted" now finds meta-quotes.md, which the raw text's YAML quoting hid. No other s185 value moved. 2026-10-08 (#1206, human-decided): the frontier block frames its hits as untrusted under the lead line; the six s185/s186/pushes values that hold a block were re-observed, and each equals the prior value once the frame lines are removed. 2026-10-08 (#1206): the Lessons note now stands only over framed text; s062's three sections with no framed text ('both lessons calls fail', 'both lessons calls empty', 'the shim is missing from the tree') lost the note and nothing else.
